about: The checkered flag is about to drop on a new Virtual Reality racing experience!
Get in the drivers’ seat of your own customized kart and race against other players.
Race through stunning environments, collect power ups and use weapons to gain the upper hand over other racers.
VR Karts is a fun and family-friendly racing game designed specifically for Virtual Reality.
Network Players 2-6 - Full game requires PlayStation®Plus membership to access online multiplayer
PlayStation®VR and PlayStation®Camera is required to play this product
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation Network is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
